scientific_limitations: Deterministic homogeneous model, no basal transcription, unequal degradation, noise, signaling delay or experimental inference. Only leading local synthesis-rate tolerance; not uniform as pq approaches one. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_scope: Fixed positive real Hill exponents p,q with pq>1 in the dimensionless Gardner two-repressor ODE; fold synthesis rates near their unique cusp.
title: Sharp cusp-width law for unequal-cooperativity genetic toggles
